provenance:
M41, the second half of postmortem shape S2. The per-item extracted text was a bare `<pre class="text">` — role `generic`, dropped by `observe.SKIP_ROLES` — so the largest output region on the page was unreachable by the role tier. sec-10k-extract's legibility row gives it `role="region" aria-label="Item <n> extracted text"` in BOTH view modes (that repo's own Markdown-view decision, and its D10). This case measures that a plan naming that region resolves and extracts the item text. Fixture `src/browser/fixtures/sec10k-inspector.html` is the rendered snapshot described in `sec10k-doc-status-is-a-named-status`, captured with item index 6 ("4 — Mine Safety Disclosures") selected because it is the smallest extracted item on aapl-2025 at 93 characters — a fixture carrying Item 1A's 68,162 would be a 68KB file grading nothing extra. Ground truth from `/api/extract/fixture` (rule 6 per-site ground-truth endpoint, eval side only), re-verified 2026-08-26 against `git_sha` `6b37ffa99d05`: item `4`, status `extracted`, `chars` 93. Watched RED first two ways: (1) `expect.answer` a placeholder — `answer_matches: false`, reason `answer 'Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures

Not applicable.

Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 18

PART II' != expected 'PLACEHOLDER'`; (2) with `role="region" aria-label="Item 4 extracted text"` stripped from the fixture's `<pre class="text">` — the pre-legibility shape, recorded verbatim in this file's `triage.red_first`. **Build provenance, corrected after cold review — three shas are involved and only two of them are the same thing.** `/api/meta` answered `5a44758598f5` when this milestone started and `6b37ffa99d05` at probe time. But the captured page's own footer — which the page fills from that same `/api/meta` field, one line of its own script — already read `build 6b37ffa99d05` in the FIRST capture, taken while `curl` to the same endpoint was still answering `5a44758598f5`. The two reads disagreed inside one session, which is what a rolling deploy across containers looks like; that explanation is INFERRED, not measured, and is written as an inference on purpose. What is measured: the committed snapshot is a capture of the build that reported itself as `6b37ffa99d05`, which is the same build ADR-030's probe ran against, so the fixture and the probe agree on one build rather than straddling two. The capture was re-taken later, after `/api/meta` had caught up, and diffed against the committed one — identical apart from a single `total_ms` figure inside the extraction evidence (227.6 -> 221.1), which is what that agreement looks like from the other side. The first version of this note claimed the capture was taken at `5a44758598f5`; the page says otherwise and the page is the artifact. Nothing in this repo reads either sha back — `tasks/TODO.md` T-M41-3 is the debt block for that, and D28's build-expiry rule is why it matters.

triage.red_first: with `role="region" aria-label="Item 4 extracted text"` removed from the fixture's `<pre class="text">`, the run is `failure:locate`: `step 3 (extract): relocation after locate failure: retargeting as {'text': 'Item 4 extracted text'}; ResolveError: no tier resolved {'text': 'Item 4 extracted text'}`. The relocation rung retargets on the accessible name it was denied, and a name that only ever existed as an `aria-label` is not page text, so nothing resolves — exactly the shape the postmortem predicted for the demo.
triage.note: This case says the region RESOLVES, not that a planner could have named it: the page-level observation stops before it, which is what `sec10k-item-text-region-is-past-the-observation-cap` pins. The pair is the finding, the same way `live-quotes-js-role-tier-blind` and `live-quotes-js-text-tier-reaches` are a pair.
